human_title: SYNTHETIC: Stream dropped and the printer did not answer HTTP probes either
limits: Probes show whether Klipper answers; they do not show whether the print continues.
Only the first drop of the capture is examined.
missing_data: Whether the printer or only the network path is down.
safe_actions: Check the printer itself (screen, power) and the network before concluding anything.

human_title: SYNTHETIC: Observation incomplete: absence of data is not evidence of absence
limits: A lost or timed-out connection does not mean the printer stopped or failed.
safe_actions: Do not infer the machine state from the loss of connection; check the printer itself.
